title: Functional 53/54-way score32 local temporal reducer with GQA8-banked eight-wave persistence
hypothesis: A separate GQA8-compatible exact-partial local temporal reducer can preserve one exact aggregate across 8 heads x 16 slices x 8 waves, using the existing staged local reducer and exact merge while advancing waves only on the validated terminal head-lane beat.

direct_comparison.primary_question: Can the 53/54-way local exact hierarchy consume producer-compatible GQA8 local-root streams, retain exact temporal state across eight waves, and emit the full 128-beat aggregate without collapsing waves on each per-head last marker?
include: 128-bank temporal exact state across 8 heads x 16 slices
explicit head-base plus lane contract validation
ideal-interface service and separate stressed ready/valid evidence
structured RTL/perf equivalence for every emitted beat
exclude: frontier promotion from functional simulation alone
new sweep or evaluation dispatch in this change

remaining_abstractions: NoC and SRAM PPA remain open.
